slot_scores.name: no_production_during_training_period
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether trainers or trainees can produce food during the two-week training period; its questions focused only on the fully-trained-by-week-8 requirement.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total cost over the 8 weeks, where total cost includes all wages (skilled, trainee, and post-training new workers), overtime premiums, and late-delivery compensation fees?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the optimization goal is to minimize total cost, directly covering the hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The conversation degenerated into a repeated loop on the same question and ended without any READY_TO_MODEL or final modeling state, so there was no clear stop; H1 (lost production during training) remained unresolved.

summary: The agent correctly recovered the objective (H2) but then became stuck repeating the fully-trained-by-week-8 question many times and never asked about production participation during training (H1); the interview collapsed into a loop without reaching a modeling-ready state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
